newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold up, volume jumps on new demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold up, volume jumps on new demand.

text.p: Gold volume jumped on the Istanbul gold exchange on Friday due to fresh demand in the afternoon on a rising world market, dealers said.

Gold closed at $381.10 an ounce, up $1.40 from Thursday's close. In lira terms it firmed to 1,137,500 from 1,129,750 on currency weakness. The lira closed down at 92,520 to the dollar after a 92,415 Thursday close.

Trading was lively in the second session on free market demand fuelled by expectations world prices would rise further in the coming days. Volume jumped to 667 kilos on Friday after Thursday's 202 and Wednesday's 310 kilos.
"In the first session the market was quiet due to cash demand in the money market, but purchases came in the afternoon," a trader said.
